description: This source file defines the internal class DirectoryMembershipSnapshot used in Orleans runtime to manage and query the membership and partitioning of silos in a cluster, including ring ranges and hash-based partition mappings.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Manages cluster silo membership data and ring ranges for partitioning, allowing lookup of ownership for grains and management of ring boundary data.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.RangeCollection
classes.description: Provides a read-only list interface over the ring ranges and their associated member and partition indices.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot.RangeCollection.RangeCollectionEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerator for iterating over the range collection.

methods.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor, initializes snapshot from cluster membership snapshot and grain factory.

methods.name: GetRange
methods.description: Returns the ring range for a specific silo address and partition.

methods.name: GetMemberRanges
methods.description: Returns all ring ranges associated with a silo address.

methods.name: GetMemberRangesByPartition
methods.description: Returns ring ranges by partition for a given silo address.

methods.name: TryGetOwner
methods.description: Attempts to find the owner silo and partition for a given grain hash code.
